Tracks r7: every §0 number re-measured on v2 — run-ups are shorter not longer (10 m -> 10.2 m/s), 22 deg lips loop the gas-through-the-lip rider, crawl climb limit 37 deg and 45 tops only over a 0.3 m kicker foot, hop-able ledge 0.3-0.6 m, every 29 deg see-saw crashes every rider — all 15 courses re-authored to those limits, lab ledge 0.10 m lower, medals from the v2 bot; v1 unit test no longer pins a harness recording

Perf on phones: always-on FPS meter top-right (fps · worst frame ms · tier), frame cap 30 on phones / 60 desktop with a Settings row, phones start on low and the probe may only step up to medium — the probe had been promoting a 60 fps start line to high (SSAO + bloom + shadows at 3000 px wide)

Menus: hidden screens and run overlays are out of hit-testing (visibility + pointer-events on every descendant), a click within 250 ms of a screen change is swallowed, a fixed Menu pill on every front screen; the lab HUD's .lab class had hijacked the settings row labels (Reset/Reload piled top-right); loader is two honest bars — DOWNLOAD (bytes needed to start) and SETUP (weighted boot steps with in-step progress), whole numbers only
